items.description: Elsy Arres Flights is a web application that lets users search for upcoming flights by providing their departure location, and their destination. This application uses the Elsy Arres Flights API service.
Like tinyurl, but for maps. Create a map, add routes or points of interest, and get a short URL to share it or come back to it later.
User driven search where users contribute listings, reviews, pictures, tags, and more. Toronto is first city setup, includes mapped traffic conditions.
French real estate prices. Charts, maps, median prices. Time line of prices over time. Housing data from France.
How many nuclear weapons are in range of your home city? A simple awareness tool based on data from The Guardian.
Embeddable driving directions widget. Create driving directions for your site, with an animated Street View tour of your route.
Deals, discounts and offers worldwide, shown on a map.
The Charlottetown Transit Map is a PHP and JavaScript application that uses Google Maps to display up-to-the-minute information about the buses in Charlottetown. From Peter Rukavina.

Near Here is a travel-ready, lead-generating iPhone app that helps you find, research and contact leads. The D&B Direct API Near Here web app extends the power of the Hoover's Near Here mobile application to your enterprise sales tools.
Image search in the 2 million royalty free images in photo bank Fotolia. Also use it to create instant e-cards.
Waitlist management built using Twilio and Twilio SMS APIs. Schedule notifications, predefined messages and auto responses. Data analytics galore.
